title: SwapCommand
description: When pressing the item swap button "F", it executes a command.
body:
This plugin allows you to configure a command that is executed when a specific item swap action occurs. (default button F)

## Features:

**Permissions:**

```swapcommand.use``` – Allows players to use the item swap functionality.

```swapcommand.admin``` – Grants administrative permissions for advanced plugin controls.

**Configurable Command Execution:**

You can specify the exact command that will be triggered when the item swap action takes place.

**Usage Example:**

Set the command to "help" in the config, so when the item swap button is pressed, the /help command will be executed.
